novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that “reasoning trace length is controlled by a low-dimensional, causally manipulable subspace” and that a long-versus-short activation vector can “smoothly modulate verbosity at inference without retraining,” so its novelty route is explicitly a mechanism and intervention for reasoning-length control. Searches for “activation steering chain-of-thought length,” “reasoning length steering vector activations,” and “causal reasoning-strength direction” identify Activation Steering for Chain-of-Thought Compression (2025), which already extracts and injects a training-free steering vector to shorten CoTs while preserving accuracy, and On Reasoning Strength Planning in Large Reasoning Models (2025), which reports a directional activation vector whose magnitude causally increases or decreases reasoning-token count. The proposed matched-trace construction and verification-loop analysis are minor operational variations, while the core phenomenon and method are essentially equivalent to those works rather than a new core relationship.
